daas-irab:99-99.t: ﴿ما﴾ negating, with no governing effect. ﴿عَلَى الرَّسُولِ﴾ attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿الْبَلاغُ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject); and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; الله, the Name of Majesty, is mubtadaʾ, and its khabar is the clause يعلم. ﴿ما تُبْدُونَ﴾ ما: a relative noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause تبدون is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; the clause ﴿تَكْتُمُونَ﴾ is conjoined; and the clause والله يعلم.. is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:100-100.t:
﴿قُلْ﴾ imperative verb; its fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun implied as «you»; and the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿لا يَسْتَوِي الْخَبِيثُ﴾ imperfect verb and fāʿil; لا is negating; and the clause is the speech reported by «say» (maqūl al-qawl), a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَالطَّيِّبُ﴾ conjoined. ﴿وَلَوْ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); لو is a non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿أَعْجَبَكَ كَثْرَةُ الْخَبِيثِ﴾ past verb, its object and its fāʿil; and ﴿الْخَبِيثُ﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive; and the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ﴾ imperative verb and its fāʿil, and the Name of Majesty is its object; the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa; and the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition, the implied form being: «if the matter is so, then fear Allah».
The apodosis of لو is likewise omitted, the implied form being: «even if the abundance of the evil pleases you, it is not equal to the good». ﴿يا أُولِي﴾ the one addressed (munādā), accusative with the yāʾ, treated like the sound masculine plural. ﴿الْأَلْبابِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ﴾ لعلّ: a particle resembling the verb; the kāf is its noun; and the clause تفلحون is in the position of nominative as its khabar (predicate).

daas-irab:101-101.t: ﴿يا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا﴾ its i'rab has preceded. ﴿لا تَسْئَلُوا﴾ imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the lā of prohibition, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); and the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿أَشْياءَ﴾ a genitive noun, genitive with the fatḥa instead of the kasra because it ends in the extended alif of femininity; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) تسألوا. ﴿إِنْ تُبْدَ لَكُمْ﴾ [تبد] imperfect verb, jussive by the dropping of the weak letter, to which the preposition and its genitive noun after it are attached; it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is «it», referring to أشياء. ﴿تَسُؤْكُمْ﴾ imperfect verb, the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the kāf is its object and its fāʿil refers to أشياء; and the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a condition not joined to the fāʾ. ﴿وَإِنْ تَسْئَلُوا عَنْها حِينَ يُنَزَّلُ الْقُرْآنُ تُبْدَ لَكُمْ﴾ إن is conditional; تسألوا is the protasis; the clause is conjoined; the clause تبد لكم is the apodosis, with no grammatical position; and the clause ينزل القرآن is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa) after the adverb حين, which is attached to the verb تسألوا. ﴿عَفَا اللَّهُ عَنْها﴾ past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun عنها are attached; the Name of Majesty is its fāʿil; and the clause is in the position of genitive as an adjective of أشياء. ﴿وَاللَّهُ غَفُورٌ﴾ the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ (subject) and غفور khabar (predicate); and the clause is resumptive. ﴿حَلِيمٌ﴾ second khabar.

daas-irab:102-102.t: ﴿قَدْ سَأَلَها قَوْمٌ﴾ past verb, its object and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿قَدْ﴾ a particle of verification (taḥqīq). ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ﴾ attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them; and the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿ثُمَّ أَصْبَحُوا﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, and the wāw is its noun. ﴿بِها﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the khabar (predicate) ﴿كافِرِينَ﴾; and the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:103-103.t: ﴿ما جَعَلَ اللَّهُ مِنْ بَحِيرَةٍ﴾ ما is negating, with no governing effect. جعل: past verb meaning «made into» (صيّر), taking two objects, the second of which is omitted, i.e. «Allah has not made any animal a baḥīra». من is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; بحيرة: a noun genitive in form, accusative in position, as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَلا سائِبَةٍ﴾ conjoined to بحيرة; and لا is redundant, to emphasize the negation; and likewise ﴿وَلا وَصِيلَةٍ﴾. ﴿وَلا حامٍ﴾ conjoined, genitive with the kasra implied (muqaddara) on the omitted yāʾ, because it is a defective noun (ism manqūṣ) with tanwīn. The clause ما جعل is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿لكِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا﴾ لكنّ: a particle resembling the verb; the relative noun is in the position of accusative as its noun; and the clause كفروا is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿يَفْتَرُونَ عَلَى اللَّهِ الْكَذِبَ﴾ imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun after it are attached (mutaʿalliq); the wāw is its fāʿil (agent) and الكذب its object; and the clause is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of لكنّ. ﴿وَأَكْثَرُهُمْ لا يَعْقِلُونَ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). أكثر: mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause لا يعقلون is its khabar; and the nominal clause وأكثرهم is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), or resumptive with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:104-104.t:
﴿وَإِذا قِيلَ لَهُمْ﴾ past verb, passive, to which the preposition and its genitive noun after it are attached (mutaʿalliq); and the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa) after the conditional إذا. ﴿تَعالَوْا إِلى ما أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ﴾ تعالوا: imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, to which the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿إِلى ما﴾ are attached; the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the clause أنزل is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun ما, with no grammatical position; and the clause تعالوا is the speech reported by the verb of saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَإِلَى الرَّسُولِ﴾ conjoined to إلى ما أنزل. ﴿قالُوا﴾ the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of the condition إذا. ﴿حَسْبُنا ما وَجَدْنا عَلَيْهِ آباءَنا﴾ حسبنا: mubtadaʾ (subject), and نا is in the position of genitive by annexation; ما: a relative noun in the position of nominative as khabar (predicate). وجدنا: past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, its fāʿil and its object; and the nominal clause حسبنا ما وجدنا is the speech reported by the verb of saying, a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿أَوَلَوْ﴾ the hamza is for interrogation, and the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). لو is a non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿كانَ آباؤُهُمْ لا يَعْلَمُونَ شَيْئاً﴾ كان and its noun, and the clause لا يعلمون is its khabar; and the clause is circumstantial, after the wāw of circumstance. And the clause ﴿وَلا يَهْتَدُونَ﴾ is conjoined.

daas-irab:105-105.t: ﴿يا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا﴾ its i'rab has preceded. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ أَنْفُسَكُمْ﴾ عليكم: a verbal noun of command (ism fiʿl amr) meaning «guard», its fāʿil (agent) a latent (mustatir) pronoun. أنفسكم: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the kāf is an attached pronoun in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa), and the mīm is for the plural. ﴿لا يَضُرُّكُمْ﴾ يضر: imperfect verb; the kāf is its object and the relative noun ﴿مَنْ﴾ its fāʿil; لا is negating, with no governing effect; and the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿ضَلَّ﴾ past verb; and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿إِذَا اهْتَدَيْتُمْ﴾ إذا: an adverbial, conditional, non-jussive particle, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied apodosis, i.e. «if you are guided, he who has gone astray cannot harm you». اهتديتم: past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn; the tāʾ is its fāʿil; and the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation. ﴿إِلَى اللَّهِ مَرْجِعُكُمْ جَمِيعاً﴾ إلى الله: attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) مرجعكم, i.e. «your return is going to Allah». جميعا: a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative. And the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَيُنَبِّئُكُمْ بِما كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ﴾ the fāʾ is conjunctive. ينبئكم: imperfect verb, nominative, and the kāf is its object. بما: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the verb before them. The clause كنتم is the ṣila of the relative noun ما, and the clause تعملون is in the position of accusative as the khabar of كان.

daas-irab:9-10.t: ﴿وَعَدَ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا﴾ a past verb; the Name of Majesty is its fāʿil (agent), the relative noun is its object, and the clause after it is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحاتِ﴾ conjoined; the second object is omitted, its implied form being "gardens" (جنات). ﴿لَهُمْ مَغْفِرَةٌ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) مغفرة. ﴿وَأَجْرٌ﴾ conjoined to مغفرة. ﴿عَظِيمٌ﴾ a naʿt (adjective), and the nominal clause is resumptive with no grammatical position. ﴿وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا﴾ a relative noun as mubtadaʾ, and the clause after it is the ṣila. ﴿وَكَذَّبُوا بِآياتِنا﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to كذبوا, and the clause is conjoined to كفروا. ﴿أُولئِكَ أَصْحابُ﴾ the demonstrative is a mubtadaʾ and أصحاب the khabar. ﴿الْجَحِيمِ﴾ a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the nominal clause is the khabar of الذين, and the clause والذين is resumptive.

daas-irab:11-11.t: ﴿يا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا﴾ its i'rab has preceded. ﴿اذْكُرُوا نِعْمَتَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ﴾ its i'rab has preceded in verse no. 8 [Translator's note: so in the source; the phrase is parsed under verse 7]. ﴿إِذْ﴾ an adverb for past time attached to (mutaʿalliq) نعمة. ﴿هَمَّ قَوْمٌ أَنْ يَبْسُطُوا إِلَيْكُمْ أَيْدِيَهُمْ﴾ همّ is a past verb and قوم the fāʿil (agent); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from the verb يبسط and أن is in the position of the genitive by a preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to همّ. ﴿إِلَيْكُمْ﴾ the two are attached to the verb before them. ﴿أَيْدِيَهُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿هَمَّ﴾ is in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿فَكَفَّ أَيْدِيَهُمْ عَنْكُمْ﴾ a past verb and its object, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَعَلَى اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty is genitive by على, the two being attached to the verb after them; the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive; يتوكل is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the lām of command, and المؤمنون is its fāʿil.

daas-irab:12-12.t: ﴿وَلَقَدْ أَخَذَ اللَّهُ مِيثاقَ﴾ أخذ is a past verb, the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil (agent) and ميثاق the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the lām in ولقد occurs in the response to an implied oath; the wāw is resumptive; قد is a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq); and the clause is the response to the omitted oath. ﴿بَنِي﴾ a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr) with the yāʾ because it is treated like a sound masculine plural, the nūn being dropped for annexation. ﴿إِسْرائِيلَ﴾ a muḍāf ilayhi, genitive with the fatḥa because of being a proper name and foreign. ﴿وَبَعَثْنا مِنْهُمُ اثْنَيْ عَشَرَ نَقِيباً﴾ اثني is a mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb) with the yāʾ because it is dual, and عشر is a [numeral] component, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, with no grammatical position. ﴿نَقِيباً﴾ a tamyīz (specification); the preposition and its genitive noun منهم are attached (mutaʿalliq) to it. ﴿وَقالَ اللَّهُ إِنِّي مَعَكُمْ﴾ معكم is an adverb of place attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of inna; the nominal clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech), and the clause of saying is conjoined. ﴿لَئِنْ أَقَمْتُمُ الصَّلاةَ﴾ أقمتم is a past verb in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), with its fāʿil and its object; the lām paves the way for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa li-l-qasam), and إن is a jussivizing conditional particle. ﴿وَآتَيْتُمُ الزَّكاةَ﴾ conjoined. ﴿وَآمَنْتُمْ بِرُسُلِي﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb before them. ﴿وَعَزَّرْتُمُوهُمْ﴾ a past verb; the tāʾ is its fāʿil and the hāʾ its object, and the wāw is for saturating (ishbāʿ) the ḍamma. ﴿وَأَقْرَضْتُمُ اللَّهَ قَرْضاً حَسَناً﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the Name of Majesty is its object and قرضا a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿حَسَناً﴾ a naʿt (adjective), and the clause, like the ones before it, is conjoined. ﴿لَأُكَفِّرَنَّ عَنْكُمْ سَيِّئاتِكُمْ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb before them. ﴿سَيِّئاتِكُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative with the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural; the lām occurs in the response to the oath, and the clause is the response to the oath with no grammatical position; the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by the response to the oath that precedes it. ﴿وَلَأُدْخِلَنَّكُمْ جَنَّاتٍ﴾ جنات is a second mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is conjoined; the clause ﴿تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهارُ﴾ is a naʿt. ﴿فَمَنْ كَفَرَ﴾ من is a conditional noun, a mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿كَفَرَ﴾ a past verb in the position of the jussive as the protasis; the clause ﴿من كَفَرَ﴾ is resumptive. ﴿بَعْدَ ذلِكَ﴾ the adverb of time بعد is attached to كفر, and the demonstrative is in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿مِنْكُمْ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿فَقَدْ ضَلَّ﴾ the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis. ﴿سَواءَ السَّبِيلِ﴾ a mafʿūl bihi; السبيل is a muḍāf ilayhi; and the protasis and its apodosis are the khabar of the mubtadaʾ من.

daas-irab:13-13.t:
﴿فَبِما نَقْضِهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) لعناهم, and ما is redundant (zāʾida). ﴿مِيثاقَهُمْ﴾ the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the maṣdar (verbal noun) before it. ﴿لَعَنَّاهُمْ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَجَعَلْنا قُلُوبَهُمْ قاسِيَةً﴾ قاسية is a second mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿يُحَرِّفُونَ الْكَلِمَ عَنْ مَواضِعِهِ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb, and the clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَنَسُوا حَظًّا﴾ the clause is conjoined. ﴿مِمَّا﴾ the two are attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of حظا. ﴿ذُكِّرُوا بِهِ﴾ ذكروا is a past verb, passive (mabnī li-l-majhūl), to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; the wāw is its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَلا تَزالُ تَطَّلِعُ عَلى خائِنَةٍ﴾ لا تزال is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb; its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "you" (أنت), and the clause تطلع is its khabar (predicate). ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾ the two are attached to خائنة. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of exception. ﴿قَلِيلًا﴾ an accusative excepted noun, to which the preposition and its genitive noun after it are attached. ﴿فَاعْفُ عَنْهُمْ﴾ اعف is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the weak letter, to which the preposition and its genitive noun after it are attached; the fāʿil is "you" (أنت); the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ implying an omitted condition), and the clause is the apodosis of an implied condition, with no grammatical position.
﴿وَاصْفَحْ﴾ conjoined. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْمُحْسِنِينَ﴾ the clause gives the reason (taʿlīliyya) and has no grammatical position. The clause ﴿يُحِبُّ﴾ is the khabar of inna.

daas-irab:14-14.t: ﴿وَمِنَ الَّذِينَ﴾ the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb أخذنا after them, and the clause ﴿قالُوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿إِنَّا نَصارى﴾ inna, with نا as its noun and نصارى as its khabar (predicate); the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech). ﴿أَخَذْنا مِيثاقَهُمْ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَنَسُوا حَظًّا مِمَّا ذُكِّرُوا بِهِ﴾ its i'rab has preceded in the previous verse, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَأَغْرَيْنا بَيْنَهُمُ الْعَداوَةَ﴾ أغرينا is a past verb and its fāʿil; العداوة is the mafʿūl bihi, and the adverb بين is attached to the verb; the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِلى يَوْمِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from what precedes them. ﴿الْقِيامَةِ﴾ a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَسَوْفَ يُنَبِّئُهُمُ اللَّهُ﴾ ينبئهم الله: an imperfect verb and a mafʿūl bihi, and the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil; سوف is a particle of the future, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿بِما كانُوا يَصْنَعُونَ﴾ the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun ما; the clause ﴿يَصْنَعُونَ﴾ is the khabar of كانوا; and بما: the two are attached to ينبئهم.

daas-irab:15-16.t: ﴿يا أَهْلَ الْكِتابِ﴾ أهل is the one addressed (munādā), muḍāf, accusative (manṣūb); الكتاب is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿قَدْ جاءَكُمْ رَسُولُنا﴾ a past verb and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and رسولنا is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿يُبَيِّنُ لَكُمْ﴾ the clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿كَثِيراً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مِمَّا كُنْتُمْ تُخْفُونَ مِنَ الْكِتابِ﴾ the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun ما; the clause ﴿تُخْفُونَ﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of كنتم; and مما: the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) كثيرا. ﴿وَيَعْفُوا عَنْ كَثِيرٍ﴾ the clause is conjoined; and من الكتاب: the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl from the omitted referent pronoun: "of what you used to conceal (مما تخفونه)". ﴿قَدْ جاءَكُمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ نُورٌ﴾ a past verb and a mafʿūl bihi, and نور is the fāʿil; the Name of Majesty is genitive by على [Translator's note: so in the source; the preposition in the verse is من], the two being attached to an omitted ḥāl from نور, since they precede it. ﴿وَكِتابٌ مُبِينٌ﴾ conjoined, and مبين is a naʿt (adjective); the clause is resumptive. ﴿يَهْدِي بِهِ اللَّهُ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil; ﴿بِهِ﴾: the two are attached to the verb. ﴿مَنِ اتَّبَعَ رِضْوانَهُ﴾ the relative noun is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi, and رضوانه is a first mafʿūl bihi [Translator's note: so in the source; من is the first object of يهدي and رضوانه is the object of اتبع]; the clause after it is the ṣila. ﴿سُبُلَ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿السَّلامِ﴾ a muḍāf ilayhi; the clause ﴿يَهْدِي﴾ is a naʿt of كتاب. ﴿وَيُخْرِجُهُمْ مِنَ الظُّلُماتِ إِلَى النُّورِ﴾ both prepositional phrases are attached to يخرجهم. ﴿بِإِذْنِهِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿وَيَهْدِيهِمْ إِلى صِراطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ﴾ the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:17-17.t: ﴿لَقَدْ كَفَرَ الَّذِينَ قالُوا﴾ the relative noun الذين is the fāʿil (agent) of كفر; the clause is the response to an oath, and the lām occurs in the response to the oath; the clause ﴿قالُوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ inna, with the Name of Majesty as its noun; and ﴿هُوَ﴾ is a detached nominative pronoun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿الْمَسِيحُ﴾ its khabar (predicate), and the nominal clause ﴿هُوَ الْمَسِيحُ﴾ is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of inna. ﴿ابْنُ﴾ a nominative naʿt (adjective) or badal (substitute). ﴿مَرْيَمَ﴾ a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr) with the fatḥa, a diptote (mamnūʿ min al-ṣarf) because of being a proper name and feminine; the clause ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech). ﴿قُلْ: فَمَنْ يَمْلِكُ مِنَ اللَّهِ شَيْئاً﴾ the interrogative noun من is a mubtadaʾ and the clause after it is its khabar; the fāʾ is redundant (zāʾida); the clause ﴿فَمَنْ يَمْلِكُ﴾ is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿إِنْ أَرادَ أَنْ يُهْلِكَ الْمَسِيحَ﴾ أراد is a past verb in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from أن and the verb after it is its object, and المسيح is the object of يهلك. ﴿ابْنُ﴾ a naʿt or badal. ﴿مَرْيَمَ﴾ a muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَأُمَّهُ﴾ conjoined to المسيح. ﴿وَمَنْ فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ conjoined to أمه, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted ṣila of من. ﴿جَمِيعاً﴾ a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَلِلَّهِ مُلْكُ السَّماواتِ وَالْأَرْضِ﴾ the Name of Majesty is genitive by the lām, the two being attached to the omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ ملك; السموات is a muḍāf ilayhi; and the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَما بَيْنَهُما﴾ conjoined to ملك [Translator's note: so in the source; ما is more naturally conjoined to السماوات], and the adverb بينهما is attached to the omitted ṣila of the ما before it. ﴿يَخْلُقُ ما يَشاءُ﴾ the relative noun ما is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and the clause after it is the ṣila; the clause ﴿يَخْلُقُ﴾ is resumptive. ﴿وَاللَّهُ عَلى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ﴾ the Name of Majesty is a mubtadaʾ, the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the khabar قدير, and the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:18-19.t: ﴿وَقالَتِ الْيَهُودُ وَالنَّصارى﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿نَحْنُ أَبْناءُ اللَّهِ﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate); the Name of Majesty is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech). ﴿وَأَحِبَّاؤُهُ﴾ conjoined to أبناء. ﴿قُلْ فَلِمَ يُعَذِّبُكُمْ بِذُنُوبِكُمْ﴾ ما is an interrogative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) يعذبكم; the alif of ما is dropped because the preposition has entered upon it; the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ implying an omitted condition), i.e. "if you are so, then why does He punish you?"; the clause is the apodosis of an implied condition with no grammatical position, and the protasis and its apodosis are the maqūl al-qawl; the clause ﴿قُلْ﴾ is resumptive. ﴿بَلْ أَنْتُمْ بَشَرٌ﴾ a mubtadaʾ and khabar; بل is a particle of digression (iḍrāb), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿مِمَّنْ خَلَقَ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun ممن are attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of بشر, and the clause خلق is the ṣila (relative clause) of من. ﴿يَغْفِرُ لِمَنْ يَشاءُ﴾ لمن: the two are attached to يغفر; the clause is resumptive, and the clause يشاء is the ṣila. ﴿وَيُعَذِّبُ مَنْ يَشاءُ﴾ conjoined to يغفر. ﴿وَلِلَّهِ مُلْكُ السَّماواتِ وَالْأَرْضِ﴾ its i'rab has preceded in the previous verse. ﴿وَإِلَيْهِ الْمَصِيرُ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ المصير, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿يا أَهْلَ الْكِتابِ﴾ it has preceded in verse 15. ﴿عَلى فَتْرَةٍ﴾ the two are attached to جاءكم. ﴿مِنَ الرُّسُلِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted naʿt of فترة. ﴿أَنْ تَقُولُوا﴾ the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from أن and the verb is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), on the assumption that the muḍāf is omitted, i.e. "out of dislike of your saying" (كراهة قولكم); or it is in the position of the genitive by a preposition: "lest you say" (لئلا تقولوا). ﴿ما جاءَنا مِنْ بَشِيرٍ﴾ جاء is a past verb and نا its object; ما is negative; من is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition, and بشير is a noun genitive in form and nominative in position as the fāʿil; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿وَلا نَذِيرٍ﴾ conjoined. ﴿فَقَدْ جاءَكُمْ بَشِيرٌ﴾ a past verb, a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and the fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of an implied non-jussivizing condition, i.e. "if you claim that, then a bringer of good tidings has come to you". The fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa. ﴿وَاللَّهُ عَلى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the khabar قدير, and the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:20-20.t:
﴿وَإِذْ قالَ مُوسى لِقَوْمِهِ﴾ قال is a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq), and موسى is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation; إذ is an adverb for past time attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being "remember" (اذكر). ﴿يا قَوْمِ﴾ the one addressed (munādā), muḍāf, accusative (manṣūb) with an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the letter before the first-person yāʾ, which has been dropped for lightness. ﴿اذْكُرُوا نِعْمَتَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ﴾ اذكروا is an imperative verb and its fāʿil; نعمة is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); عليكم: the two are attached to نعمة; the Name of Majesty is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech). ﴿إِذْ جَعَلَ فِيكُمْ أَنْبِياءَ﴾ فيكم: the two are attached to جعل and they are the first object, and أنبياء is the second object; the adverb إذ is attached to نعمة, and the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿وَجَعَلَكُمْ مُلُوكاً﴾ the kāf is the first object and ملوكا the second object; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَآتاكُمْ ما﴾ the relative noun ما is the second object of آتاكم, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿لَمْ يُؤْتِ أَحَداً﴾
يؤت is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the weak letter; its fāʿil is "he" (هو) and أحدا its object; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿مِنَ الْعالَمِينَ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of أحد.

daas-irab:106-106.t:
The opening of the verse: its i'rab has preceded. ﴿شَهادَةُ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative with the ḍamma; its khabar (predicate) is اثنان, nominative with the alif because it is a dual; the implied form is: «the prescribed testimony of the bequest is the testimony of two just men from among you». ﴿بَيْنِكُمْ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the kāf is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa), and the mīm is for the plural. ﴿إِذا﴾ an adverb containing the sense of condition, attached to (mutaʿalliq) its omitted apodosis: «when [death] comes, then the testimony ...». ﴿حَضَرَ أَحَدَكُمُ الْمَوْتُ﴾ past verb, mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and fāʿil (agent); and the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation. ﴿حِينَ﴾ an adverb of time attached to حضر. ﴿الْوَصِيَّةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿اثْنانِ﴾ khabar of شهادة. ﴿ذَوا﴾ an adjective, nominative with the alif. ﴿عَدْلٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مِنْكُمْ﴾ attached to an omitted second adjective of اثنان. ﴿أَوْ آخَرانِ﴾ conjoined to ﴿اثْنانِ﴾. ﴿مِنْ غَيْرِكُمْ﴾ attached to an omitted adjective of آخران. ﴿إِنْ﴾ a jussive conditional particle. ﴿أَنْتُمْ﴾ the fāʿil of an omitted verb explained by what follows it, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, i.e. «if you travel, then two others». ﴿ضَرَبْتُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun after it are attached; the tāʾ is its fāʿil; and the clause has no grammatical position, being explicative (tafsīriyya). ﴿فَأَصابَتْكُمْ مُصِيبَةُ﴾ past verb; the tāʾ is for the feminine, the kāf its object and مصيبة its fāʿil; and the clause is conjoined to the verbal clause before it. ﴿الْمَوْتُ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿تَحْبِسُونَهُما مِنْ بَعْدِ الصَّلاةِ﴾ تحبسونهما: imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun after it are attached; the wāw is its fāʿil and the hāʾ its object.
الصلاة is muḍāf ilayhi; and the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa), or in the position of nominative as a second adjective of آخران, in which case the clause ﴿إِنْ أَنْتُمْ ضَرَبْتُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ is parenthetical (iʿtirāḍiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿فَيُقْسِمانِ بِاللَّهِ﴾ imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; the alif is its fāʿil; and the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿إِنِ ارْتَبْتُمْ﴾ past verb; the tāʾ is its fāʿil and the mīm is for the plural; it is in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the apodosis is omitted, i.e. «then make them swear»; and the clause of the condition and its apodosis is parenthetical, with no grammatical position. ﴿لا نَشْتَرِي بِهِ ثَمَناً﴾ imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; ثمنا is its object, and its fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun implied as «we»; and the clause has no grammatical position, being the response to the oath. ﴿وَلَوْ كانَ ذا قُرْبى﴾ ذا: khabar of كان, accusative with the alif because it is one of the five nouns; its noun is a latent pronoun, i.e. «even if the one for whom we testify were ...»; قربى: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive with the kasra implied (muqaddara) on the alif; the apodosis of the condition لو is omitted, the implied form being: «even if it were so, we would not sell it»; and the clause is parenthetical, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَلا نَكْتُمُ شَهادَةَ اللَّهِ﴾ conjoined to ﴿لا نَشْتَرِي بِهِ﴾. ﴿إِنَّا﴾ إنّ: a particle resembling the verb; ﴿نا﴾ its noun. ﴿إِذا﴾ a particle of response with no governing effect. ﴿لَمِنَ الْآثِمِينَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar of إنّ; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); and the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:107-107.t:
﴿فَإِنْ عُثِرَ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive. إن: a jussive conditional particle. عثر: past verb, passive. ﴿عَلى﴾ a preposition. ﴿أَنَّهُمَا﴾ the particle resembling the verb أنّ, its noun and its khabar (predicate) are interpretable as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of genitive by على; and the preposition and its genitive noun are in the position of nominative as nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of عثر, i.e. «if it is discovered or come upon that the two deserved the sin». ﴿اسْتَحَقَّا إِثْماً﴾ استحقا: past verb; the alif is its fāʿil (agent) and إثما its object; and the clause is in the position of nominative as the khabar of أنّ. ﴿فَآخَرانِ﴾ the fāʾ occurs in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); آخران: mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative with the alif; and it has been said: the fāʿil of an omitted verb, «then let two others come forward», in which case the clause يقومان is an adjective; but if آخران is a mubtadaʾ, then the clause يقومان is in the position of nominative as its khabar. ﴿يَقُومانِ﴾ imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the alif is its fāʿil. ﴿مَقامَهُما﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative. ﴿مِنَ الَّذِينَ﴾ attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective of آخران.
﴿اسْتَحَقَّ عَلَيْهِمُ الْأَوْلَيانِ﴾ past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun after it are attached; الأوليان is its fāʿil, nominative with the alif because it is a dual; and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿فَيُقْسِمانِ بِاللَّهِ﴾ the clause is conjoined to يقومان. ﴿لَشَهادَتُنا أَحَقُّ مِنْ شَهادَتِهِما﴾ mubtadaʾ and khabar, to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; the lām occurs in the response to the oath, and accordingly the clause has no grammatical position. ﴿وَمَا اعْتَدَيْنا﴾ past verb, and نا is its fāʿil; ما has no governing effect; and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿إِنَّا إِذاً لَمِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ﴾ إنّ, and نا is its noun; من الظالمين is its khabar; and the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa). إذن is a particle of response; and the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:108-108.t:
﴿ذلِكَ﴾ a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); the lām is for distance and the kāf for address. ﴿أَدْنى﴾ khabar (predicate), nominative with the implied (muqaddara) ḍamma. ﴿أَنْ يَأْتُوا﴾ imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from أن and the verb is in the position of genitive by an implied preposition, i.e. «nearer to bringing». ﴿بِالشَّهادَةِ﴾ attached to (mutaʿalliq) يأتوا. ﴿عَلى وَجْهِها﴾ attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from الشهادة. ﴿أَوْ يَخافُوا﴾ conjoined to يأتوا. ﴿أَنْ تُرَدَّ﴾ the interpreted maṣdar from أن and the verb is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿أَيْمانٌ﴾ nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of the passive verb ترد. ﴿بَعْدَ﴾ an adverb of time attached to ترد. ﴿أَيْمانِهِمْ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ﴾ imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil and الله, the Name of Majesty, its object; and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَاسْمَعُوا﴾ the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ.
And the clause ﴿لا يَهْدِي الْقَوْمَ الْفاسِقِينَ﴾ is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ الله, and the nominal clause ﴿اللَّهَ﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:109-109.t: ﴿يَوْمَ﴾ an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted verb «remember» (اذكر). ﴿يَجْمَعُ اللَّهُ الرُّسُلَ﴾ imperfect verb; the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil (agent) and الرسل the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿فَيَقُولُ﴾ conjoined to يجمع. ﴿ماذا﴾ an interrogative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿أُجِبْتُمْ﴾ past verb, passive, and the tāʾ is its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ; and the nominal clause ماذا أجبتم is the speech reported by the verb of saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿قالُوا﴾ past verb and fāʿil; and the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿لا عِلْمَ لَنا﴾ لا: the lā of generic negation. علم: its noun, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative; لنا is attached to its omitted khabar; and the clause is the speech reported by the verb of saying, in the position of accusative. ﴿إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ عَلَّامُ الْغُيُوبِ﴾ أنت علّام: mubtadaʾ and khabar, and الغيوب is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is in the position of nominative as the khabar of إنّ, and the kāf is its noun; and the clause إنك أنت is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:110-110.t: ﴿إِذْ﴾ an adverb of time, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of accusative as a badal (substitute) from يوم in the previous verse, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted verb «remember» (اذكر). ﴿قالَ اللَّهُ﴾ past verb, and the Name of Majesty is its fāʿil (agent); and the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿يا عِيسَى﴾ the one addressed (munādā), a singular proper name, indeclinable on the ḍamma, in the position of accusative. ﴿ابْنَ﴾ an adjective, accusative, and it is a muḍāf. ﴿مَرْيَمَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive with the fatḥa in place of the kasra because of being a proper name and semantically feminine. ﴿اذْكُرْ﴾ imperative, its fāʿil latent (mustatir). ﴿نِعْمَتِي﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the verb اذكر, accusative, the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa implied on the letter before the yāʾ of the first person, and the yāʾ is in the position of genitive by annexation. ﴿عَلَيْكَ﴾ attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from نعمتي; and the clause اذكر is the speech reported by the verb of saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَعَلى والِدَتِكَ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿إِذْ﴾ an adverb of time attached to an omitted ḥāl from نعمتي; and it has been said that it is a badal from it. ﴿أَيَّدْتُكَ﴾ past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn; the tāʾ is its fāʿil and the kāf its object. ﴿بِرُوحِ﴾ attached to أيدتك. ﴿الْقُدُسِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿تُكَلِّمُ النَّاسَ﴾ imperfect verb and its object; and the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl. ﴿فِي الْمَهْدِ﴾ attached to an omitted ḥāl: «as a suckling in the cradle». ﴿وَكَهْلًا﴾ conjoined to the omitted ḥāl. ﴿وَإِذْ عَلَّمْتُكَ الْكِتابَ وَالْحِكْمَةَ وَالتَّوْراةَ وَالْإِنْجِيلَ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it; and الكتاب is the second object. ﴿وَإِذْ تَخْلُقُ مِنَ الطِّينِ كَهَيْئَةِ الطَّيْرِ﴾ من الطين and كهيئة الطير are attached to the verb تخلق. ﴿بِإِذْنِي﴾ attached to an omitted ḥāl from الطير; and the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation; the clause ﴿فَتَنْفُخُ فِيها﴾ is conjoined to it; and likewise the clause ﴿فَتَكُونُ طَيْراً بِإِذْنِي﴾ is conjoined; the noun of تكون is a latent pronoun implied as «it», and طيرا is its khabar (predicate); the preposition and its genitive noun بإذني are attached to an omitted adjective of ﴿طَيْراً﴾. The clause ﴿وَتُبْرِئُ الْأَكْمَهَ وَالْأَبْرَصَ بِإِذْنِي﴾ is conjoined, and بإذني is attached to the verb ﴿تُبْرِئُ﴾. And likewise the clause ﴿وَإِذْ تُخْرِجُ الْمَوْتى بِإِذْنِي﴾ is conjoined. ﴿وَإِذْ كَفَفْتُ بَنِي إِسْرائِيلَ عَنْكَ﴾ بني: direct object, accusative with the yāʾ because it is treated like the sound masculine plural; إسرائيل: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive with the fatḥa in place of the kasra because of being a proper name and foreign; and عنك is attached to كففت. ﴿إِذْ﴾ an adverb, also attached to كففت. ﴿جِئْتَهُمْ بِالْبَيِّناتِ﴾ past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun after it are attached; the tāʾ is its fāʿil and the hāʾ its object; and the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation. ﴿فَقالَ الَّذِينَ﴾ past verb, and the relative noun is the fāʿil; and the clause is conjoined. ﴿كَفَرُوا مِنْهُمْ﴾ past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; the wāw is its fāʿil; and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿إِنْ هذا إِلَّا سِحْرٌ﴾ إن is negating. هذا: mubtadaʾ (subject), and سحر its khabar. إلا: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿مُبِينٌ﴾ an adjective. And the clause is the speech reported by the verb of saying.

daas-irab:111-111.t: ﴿وَإِذْ﴾ an adverb of time. ﴿أَوْحَيْتُ إِلَى الْحَوارِيِّينَ﴾ past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq); the tāʾ is its fāʿil (agent); and the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿أَنْ آمِنُوا بِي وَبِرَسُولِي﴾ أن is explicative (mufassira), and it has been said maṣdar-forming (maṣdariyya); and the clause after it is explicative. The clause ﴿قالُوا﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position; the clause ﴿آمَنَّا﴾ is the speech reported by the verb of saying (maqūl al-qawl); and the clause ﴿وَاشْهَدْ﴾ is conjoined. ﴿بِأَنَّنا مُسْلِمُونَ﴾ أنّ, its noun and its khabar (predicate); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is in the position of genitive by the bāʾ; and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb اشهد before them.

daas-irab:112-112.t: ﴿إِذْ﴾ an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted verb «remember» (اذكر); and the clause ﴿قالَ الْحَوارِيُّونَ﴾ after it is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿يا عِيسَى ابْنَ مَرْيَمَ﴾ the one addressed (munādā), a singular proper name; ابن is its adjective according to the sense, or a badal (substitute); and مريم is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿هَلْ يَسْتَطِيعُ رَبُّكَ أَنْ يُنَزِّلَ﴾ imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent); أن and the verb after it are interpretable as a maṣdar (verbal noun) which is its object, i.e. «is your Lord able to send down». ﴿عَلَيْنا﴾ attached to the verb ينزل, and likewise ﴿مِنَ السَّماءِ﴾; and it is permissible to attach them to an omitted adjective of مائدة; and the clause is the speech reported by the verb of saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿قالَ﴾ the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿اتَّقُوا اللَّهَ﴾ imperative verb and fāʿil, and the Name of Majesty is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the clause is the speech reported by the verb of saying. ﴿إِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ كان, its noun and its khabar (predicate); and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, the implied form being: «if you are believers, then fear Allah in your request».

daas-irab:21-22.t: ﴿يا قَوْمِ﴾ يا is the vocative particle; قوم is the one addressed (munādā), muḍāf. ﴿ادْخُلُوا الْأَرْضَ الْمُقَدَّسَةَ﴾ an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its object; المقدسة is a naʿt (adjective). ﴿الَّتِي كَتَبَ اللَّهُ لَكُمْ﴾ the relative noun is in the position of the accusative as a second naʿt; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) كتب, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَلا تَرْتَدُّوا عَلى أَدْبارِكُمْ﴾ ترتدوا is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the lā of prohibition, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿فَتَنْقَلِبُوا﴾ conjoined to ترتدوا, jussive like it. ﴿خاسِرِينَ﴾ a ḥāl. ﴿قالُوا يا مُوسى﴾ the one addressed, a singular proper name, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma in the position of the accusative; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech). ﴿إِنَّ فِيها قَوْماً جَبَّارِينَ﴾ inna and its noun; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to its omitted khabar (predicate), and جبارين is a naʿt. ﴿وَإِنَّا لَنْ نَدْخُلَها﴾ inna and its noun, and the clause ﴿لَنْ نَدْخُلَها﴾ is its khabar; the nominal clause إنا لن.. is conjoined by the wāw. ﴿حَتَّى يَخْرُجُوا مِنْها﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after حتى; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is in the position of the genitive by حتى, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ندخلها; منها: the two are attached to يخرجوا. ﴿فَإِنْ يَخْرُجُوا مِنْها﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), to which the preposition and its genitive noun after it are attached; the wāw is its fāʿil, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَإِنَّا داخِلُونَ﴾ the fāʾ is linking; inna, with نا as its noun and داخلون as its khabar; the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ).

daas-irab:23-24.t: ﴿قالَ رَجُلانِ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ) with the alif because it is dual. ﴿مِنَ الَّذِينَ يَخافُونَ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun من الذين are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of رجلان. ﴿يَخافُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿أَنْعَمَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمَا﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is the Name of Majesty; the clause is in the position of the nominative as a second naʿt of رجلان. ﴿ادْخُلُوا عَلَيْهِمُ الْبابَ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb before them, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech). ﴿فَإِذا دَخَلْتُمُوهُ﴾ a past verb; the tāʾ is its fāʿil and the hāʾ its object; the wāw is for saturating (ishbāʿ) the ḍamma; the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation after the adverb إذا. ﴿فَإِنَّكُمْ غالِبُونَ﴾ inna, its noun and its khabar (predicate); the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussivizing condition. ﴿وَعَلَى اللَّهِ فَتَوَكَّلُوا﴾ the Name of Majesty is genitive by على, the two being attached to توكلوا, and the fāʾ is redundant (zāʾida). ﴿إِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ إن is conditional, and kāna with its noun and its khabar; the clause is conditional with no grammatical position, and the apodosis is omitted, indicated by what precedes it. ﴿قالُوا يا مُوسى إِنَّا لَنْ نَدْخُلَها﴾ its i'rab has preceded in the previous verse. ﴿أَبَداً﴾ an adverb of time attached to ندخلها. ﴿ما دامُوا فِيها﴾ an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb; the wāw is its noun, and فيها: the two are attached to the omitted khabar of دام. ﴿فَاذْهَبْ أَنْتَ﴾ an imperative verb; the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ implying an omitted condition); its fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "you" (أنت), and أنت is a tawkīd (emphasis) of the latent pronoun. ﴿وَرَبُّكَ﴾ conjoined to the latent fāʿil أنت. ﴿فَقاتِلا﴾ an imperative verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is conjoined to اذهب. ﴿إِنَّا هاهُنا قاعِدُونَ﴾ inna, its noun and its khabar; in هاهنا, the hāʾ is for drawing attention (tanbīh) and هنا is a demonstrative in the position of the accusative as an adverb of place, attached to the khabar قاعدون; the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:25-26.t:
﴿قالَ رَبِّ﴾ the one addressed (munādā) with an omitted vocative particle, muḍāf, accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its accusative being an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the letter before the dropped first-person yāʾ. ﴿إِنِّي لا أَمْلِكُ﴾ inna, with the yāʾ as its noun, and the verbal clause after it is its khabar (predicate); the clause ﴿إِنِّي﴾ is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech). ﴿إِلَّا نَفْسِي﴾ a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative with an implied fatḥa on the letter before the first-person yāʾ, and إلا is a particle of restriction. ﴿وَأَخِي﴾ conjoined to نفسي. ﴿فَافْرُقْ بَيْنَنا﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ implying an omitted condition); the adverb بيننا is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before it, and the clause is the apodosis of an implied non-jussivizing condition with no grammatical position. ﴿وَبَيْنَ﴾ conjoined to بيننا. ﴿الْقَوْمِ﴾ a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿الْفاسِقِينَ﴾ a naʿt (adjective). ﴿قالَ فَإِنَّها مُحَرَّمَةٌ﴾ inna, its noun and its khabar; the fāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ أَرْبَعِينَ﴾ an adverb of time, accusative with the yāʾ because it is treated like a sound masculine plural; it, together with the preposition and its genitive noun before it, is attached to محرمة, or it is attached to يتيهون after it.
﴿سَنَةً﴾ a tamyīz (specification). ﴿يَتِيهُونَ فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb before them, and the clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿فَلا تَأْسَ عَلَى الْقَوْمِ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the lā of prohibition, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the weak letter; the preposition and its genitive noun after it are attached to it. ﴿الْفاسِقِينَ﴾ a naʿt, and the clause is resumptive after the fāʾ.

daas-irab:27-28.t: ﴿وَاتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ﴾ an imperative verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq); نبأ is its object, and its fāʿil (agent) is "you" (أنت). ﴿ابْنَيْ﴾ a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr) with the yāʾ because it is dual, the nūn being dropped for annexation. ﴿آدَمَ﴾ a muḍāf ilayhi, genitive with the fatḥa. ﴿بِالْحَقِّ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "keeping to the truth" (ملتبسا بالحق [Translator's note: the source prints ملتمسا, evidently for ملتبسا]). ﴿إِذْ قَرَّبا قُرْباناً﴾ إذ is an adverb for past time attached to نبإ, and the verbal clause, consisting of the verb, the fāʿil and the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) after it, is in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿فَتُقُبِّلَ مِنْ أَحَدِهِما﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the passive verb before them, and the clause is conjoined by the fāʾ. ﴿وَلَمْ يُتَقَبَّلْ مِنَ الْآخَرِ﴾ conjoined to the clause before it. ﴿قالَ لَأَقْتُلَنَّكَ﴾ the lām paves the way for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa li-l-qasam) [Translator's note: so in the source; this lām is usually parsed as the lām occurring in the response to the oath]; an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because of its connection to the heavy nūn of emphasis, and the kāf is its object; the clause is the response to an implied oath with no grammatical position, and the implied verb of oath with its response is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech). ﴿قالَ إِنَّما يَتَقَبَّلُ اللَّهُ مِنَ الْمُتَّقِينَ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb before them, and the Name of Majesty is its fāʿil; إنما is the restraining and restrained (kāffa wa-makfūfa) particle, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿لَئِنْ بَسَطْتَ﴾ the lām paves the way for the oath; إن is a jussivizing conditional particle, and بسط is a past verb in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿يَدَكَ﴾ its object. ﴿إِلَيَّ﴾ the two are attached to the verb, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿لِتَقْتُلَنِي﴾ the lām is the lām of reason (taʿlīl); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from the implied أن after the lām of reason and the imperfect verb it puts in the accusative is in the position of the genitive by the preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to بسطت; the first-person yāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi. ﴿ما أَنَا بِباسِطٍ﴾ ما is negative, working like laysa; أنا is its noun; in بباسط, the bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition on its khabar (predicate); ﴿باسط﴾ is a noun genitive in form and accusative in position, because it is the khabar. ﴿يَدِيَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi of the active participle باسط. ﴿إِلَيْكَ﴾ the two are attached to the active participle. ﴿لِأَقْتُلَكَ﴾ the interpreted maṣdar formed from the implied أن and the verb is in the position of the genitive by the preposition, and the two are attached to باسط; the clause is the response to the oath with no grammatical position, and it suffices in place of the omitted apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿إِنِّي أَخافُ اللَّهَ﴾ inna and its noun, and the clause is its khabar. ﴿رَبَّ﴾ badal (substitute) of the mafʿūl bihi الله. ﴿الْعالَمِينَ﴾ a genitive muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause gives the reason (taʿlīliyya) with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:29-30.t: ﴿إِنِّي أُرِيدُ﴾ inna and its noun, and the clause ﴿أُرِيدُ﴾ is its khabar (predicate). ﴿أَنْ تَبُوءَ بِإِثْمِي﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them, and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from أن and the verb is the object of تريد [Translator's note: so in the source; the verb in the verse is أريد]. ﴿وَإِثْمِكَ﴾ conjoined to إثمي. ﴿فَتَكُونَ مِنْ أَصْحابِ النَّارِ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun من أصحاب are attached to the omitted khabar of the incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb تكون, whose noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "you" (أنت); the clause is conjoined to تبوء. ﴿النَّارِ﴾ a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَذلِكَ جَزاءُ﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar. ﴿الظَّالِمِينَ﴾ a muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is resumptive; the clause ﴿إِنِّي أُرِيدُ﴾ also gives the reason (taʿlīliyya). ﴿فَطَوَّعَتْ لَهُ نَفْسُهُ قَتْلَ﴾ طوّع is a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun له are attached; نفسه is its fāʿil (agent) and قتل its object; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَخِيهِ﴾ a muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) with the yāʾ because it is one of the five nouns. ﴿فَقَتَلَهُ﴾ the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَأَصْبَحَ مِنَ الْخاسِرِينَ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the khabar of the incomplete verb أصبح, whose noun is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "he" (هو); the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:31-31.t: ﴿فَبَعَثَ اللَّهُ غُراباً﴾ فبعث is a past verb, the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil (agent) and غرابا the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is resumptive. ﴿يَبْحَثُ فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ the clause is in the position of the accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of غرابا. ﴿لِيُرِيَهُ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām of reason (taʿlīl), and the hāʾ is its object; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is in the position of the genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) يبحث. ﴿كَيْفَ﴾ an interrogative noun in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿يُوارِي سَوْأَةَ أَخِيهِ﴾ يواري is a nominative imperfect verb, with its object; أخيه is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive with the yāʾ. ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb. ﴿يا وَيْلَتى﴾ the one addressed (munādā), muḍāf, accusative with an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the letter before the first-person yāʾ, which was changed into an alif; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech). ﴿أَعَجَزْتُ أَنْ أَكُونَ﴾ the interpreted maṣdar formed from أن and the incomplete (nāqiṣ) verb is in the position of the genitive by an implied preposition, the two being attached to عجزت; the noun of أكون is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "I" (أنا). ﴿مِثْلَ﴾ its khabar (predicate). ﴿هذَا الْغُرابِ﴾ the demonstrative is in the position of the genitive by annexation, and الغراب is a badal (substitute). ﴿فَأُوارِيَ سَوْأَةَ أَخِي﴾ conjoined to أن أكون. ﴿فَأَصْبَحَ مِنَ النَّادِمِينَ﴾ like أصبح من الخاسرين in the previous verse, and the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:32-32.t: ﴿مِنْ أَجْلِ ذلِكَ كَتَبْنا﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun من أجل are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb كتب, and نا is its fāʿil (agent); the demonstrative ذلك is in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿عَلى بَنِي﴾ a noun genitive (majrūr) with the yāʾ because it is treated like a sound masculine plural, the nūn being dropped for annexation; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to كتبنا. ﴿إِسْرائِيلَ﴾ a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive with the fatḥa. ﴿أَنَّهُ﴾ anna, with the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn) as its noun. ﴿مَنْ قَتَلَ نَفْساً بِغَيْرِ نَفْسٍ﴾ قتل is a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun بغير are attached; نفسا is its object and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the conditional noun من is in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), and نفس is a muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَوْ فَسادٍ﴾ conjoined. ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ the two are attached to the maṣdar (verbal noun) فساد. ﴿فَكَأَنَّما قَتَلَ النَّاسَ جَمِيعاً﴾ the fāʾ is linking; كأنما is the restraining and restrained (kāffa wa-makfūfa) particle; [قتل is] a past verb with its object, its fāʿil is latent, and جميعا is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَمَنْ أَحْياها فَكَأَنَّما أَحْيَا النَّاسَ جَمِيعاً﴾ its i'rab is like the i'rab of what precedes it. ﴿وَلَقَدْ جاءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُنا بِالْبَيِّناتِ﴾ جاءتهم is a past verb with its object, and رسلنا is its fāʿil; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb; the clause is the response to the oath with no grammatical position, coming after the lām that occurs in the response to the oath. ﴿ثُمَّ إِنَّ كَثِيراً مِنْهُمْ بَعْدَ ذلِكَ فِي الْأَرْضِ لَمُسْرِفُونَ﴾ inna and its noun, and لمسرفون is its khabar (predicate), the lām being the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); منهم: the two are attached to كثيرا; the adverb بعد is attached to مسرفون, and likewise the preposition and its genitive noun في الأرض. The demonstrative ذلك is in the position of the genitive by annexation, and the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:33-34.t: ﴿إِنَّما جَزاءُ الَّذِينَ﴾ جزاء is a mubtadaʾ (subject), the relative noun is in the position of the genitive by annexation, and ﴿إِنَّما﴾ is the restraining and restrained (kāffa wa-makfūfa) particle; the clause ﴿يُحارِبُونَ اللَّهَ﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَرَسُولَهُ﴾ conjoined to the Name of Majesty الله. ﴿وَيَسْعَوْنَ فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَساداً﴾ an accusative ḥāl (circumstantial), or a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). ﴿أَنْ يُقَتَّلُوا﴾ the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from the subjunctive أن and the imperfect verb is in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ جزاء, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿أَوْ يُصَلَّبُوا﴾ conjoined. ﴿أَوْ تُقَطَّعَ أَيْدِيهِمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, passive (mabnī li-l-majhūl), and أيديهم is its nāʾib fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the yāʾ because of heaviness. ﴿وَأَرْجُلُهُمْ﴾ conjoined to أيديهم. ﴿مِنْ خِلافٍ﴾ the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl from أيديهم and أرجلهم, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿أَوْ يُنْفَوْا مِنَ الْأَرْضِ﴾ a passive imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and the wāw is its nāʾib fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿ذلِكَ لَهُمْ خِزْيٌ فِي الدُّنْيا﴾ the demonstrative is a mubtadaʾ, خزي is a second mubtadaʾ, and لهم is its khabar; this nominal clause is the khabar of ذلك; في الدنيا: the two are attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of خزي. ﴿وَلَهُمْ فِي الْآخِرَةِ عَذابٌ﴾ لهم: the two are attached to the omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ عذاب; في الآخرة: the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿عَظِيمٌ﴾ a naʿt, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِلَّا الَّذِينَ﴾ the relative noun is in the position of the accusative by exception, with إلا. ﴿تابُوا مِنْ قَبْلِ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb before them, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿أَنْ تَقْدِرُوا﴾ the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ the two are attached to تقدروا. ﴿فَاعْلَمُوا﴾ an imperative verb, the wāw being the fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ﴾ anna, with the Name of Majesty as its noun, and غفور and رحيم are its two khabars; the clause takes the place of the two objects of اعلموا.

daas-irab:35-36.t: ﴿يا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا﴾ أي is the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda); the relative noun is a badal (substitute), and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿اتَّقُوا اللَّهَ﴾ an imperative verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the Name of Majesty is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَابْتَغُوا إِلَيْهِ الْوَسِيلَةَ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them or to الوسيلة after them, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَجاهِدُوا فِي سَبِيلِهِ﴾ the clause is conjoined. ﴿لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ﴾ laʿalla and its noun, and the clause تفلحون is its khabar (predicate); the clause gives the reason (taʿlīliyya). ﴿إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا﴾ inna, with the relative noun as its noun, and the clause is its khabar. ﴿لَوْ أَنَّ لَهُمْ ما فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ لهم: the two are attached to the omitted khabar of anna; في الأرض: the two are attached to an omitted ṣila; the relative noun ما is in the position of the accusative as the noun of anna [Translator's note: the source writes إن]; لو is a conditional particle. ﴿جَمِيعاً﴾ a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَمِثْلَهُ﴾ conjoined to ما. ﴿مَعَهُ﴾ an adverb of place attached to an omitted ḥāl of مثله. ﴿لِيَفْتَدُوا بِهِ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from أن and the verb is in the position of the genitive by the preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the omitted khabar of anna [Translator's note: so in the source]. ﴿مِنْ عَذابِ﴾ the two are attached to the verb before them. ﴿يَوْمِ﴾ a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿الْقِيامَةِ﴾ also a muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿ما تُقُبِّلَ مِنْهُمْ﴾ a past verb, passive (mabnī li-l-majhūl), to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussivizing condition. ﴿وَلَهُمْ عَذابٌ أَلِيمٌ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ (subject) عذاب. ﴿أَلِيمٌ﴾ a naʿt (adjective), and the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:113-113.t: ﴿قالُوا﴾ the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa), with no grammatical position. ﴿نُرِيدُ أَنْ نَأْكُلَ مِنْها﴾ the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from أن and the verb is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the verb نريد; منها is attached to (mutaʿalliq) نأكل; and the clause is the speech reported by the verb of saying (maqūl al-qawl), and the clauses after it are conjoined to it. ﴿وَنَعْلَمَ أَنْ قَدْ صَدَقْتَنا﴾ أن is lightened from the heavy [أنّ], and its noun is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn): «that you have spoken truly to us»; [صدقتنا] past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn; the tāʾ is its fāʿil (agent) and نا its object; and the clause is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of أن; and أن with what follows it is interpretable as a maṣdar which stands in place of the two objects of نعلم. ﴿وَنَكُونَ عَلَيْها مِنَ الشَّاهِدِينَ﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb whose noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun implied as «we»; من الشاهدين is attached to its omitted khabar; and عليها is attached to الشاهدين after it.

daas-irab:114-114.t: ﴿قالَ عِيسَى﴾ it is approximately like the previous verse. ﴿اللَّهُمَّ﴾ the one addressed (munādā), a singular proper name, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of accusative; the vocative yā has been dropped and compensated for by a mīm at the end of the noun. ﴿رَبَّنا﴾ the one addressed, a muḍāf, accusative, and نا is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿أَنْزِلْ﴾ a verb of supplication, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir). ﴿عَلَيْنا﴾ attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb of supplication. ﴿مائِدَةً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿مِنَ السَّماءِ﴾ attached to an adjective of مائدة. ﴿تَكُونُ لَنا عِيداً﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb whose noun is a latent pronoun implied as «it», and عيدا is its khabar (predicate); لنا is attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from عيدا, which was an adjective of it before being placed ahead of it. ﴿لِأَوَّلِنا﴾ attached to an omitted badal (substitute) from لنا. ﴿وَآخِرِنا﴾ conjoined to أولنا. ﴿وَآيَةً﴾ conjoined to عيدا. ﴿مِنْكَ﴾ attached to an omitted adjective of آية. ﴿وَارْزُقْنا﴾ the clause is conjoined to أنزل. ﴿وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الرَّازِقِينَ﴾ أنت: a detached pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); خير its khabar; ﴿الرَّازِقِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; and the clause is resumptive, or circumstantial if the wāw is for circumstance.

daas-irab:115-115.t: ﴿قالَ اللَّهُ﴾ the verbal clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿إِنِّي مُنَزِّلُها عَلَيْكُمْ﴾ إنّ; the yāʾ is its noun, and منزلها its khabar (predicate), to which the preposition and its genitive noun عليكم are attached (mutaʿalliq); and the clause is the speech reported by the verb of saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿فَمَنْ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive, and من is a jussive conditional noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), whose khabar is the clause ﴿يَكْفُرْ﴾. ﴿بَعْدُ﴾ an adverb of time, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma because it is cut off from annexation, attached to the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ) يكفر; and ﴿مِنْكُمْ﴾ is attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿فَإِنِّي أُعَذِّبُهُ﴾ the fāʾ connects the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); إنّ, and the yāʾ is its noun, and the clause أعذبه its khabar; the hāʾ is an attached pronoun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun implied as «I». ﴿عَذاباً﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿لا أُعَذِّبُهُ﴾ لا is negating; أعذب: imperfect verb; the hāʾ is an attached pronoun in the position of accusative as a substitute for the absolute object (nāʾib mafʿūl muṭlaq), because it refers back to it; and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun implied as «I». ﴿أَحَداً﴾ direct object. ﴿مِنَ الْعالَمِينَ﴾ attached to an omitted adjective of أحدا; the clause لا أعذبه أحدا is in the position of accusative as an adjective of عذابا; and the clause فإني is in the position of jussive as the apodosis.

daas-irab:116-116.t: ﴿وَإِذْ قالَ اللَّهُ: يا عِيسَى ابْنَ مَرْيَمَ﴾ the i'rab of its like has preceded. ﴿أَأَنْتَ قُلْتَ لِلنَّاسِ﴾ the hamza is for interrogation. أنت: a detached pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿قُلْتَ لِلنَّاسِ﴾ past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun after it are attached (mutaʿalliq); the tāʾ is its fāʿil (agent); and the clause is in the position of nominative as khabar (predicate). ﴿اتَّخِذُونِي﴾ imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; the nūn is for protection (nūn al-wiqāya); the wāw is the fāʿil and the yāʾ the first direct object. ﴿وَأُمِّي﴾ a noun conjoined to the yāʾ, accusative with the fatḥa implied (muqaddara) on the letter before the yāʾ of the first person, and the yāʾ is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿إِلهَيْنِ﴾ second direct object, accusative with the yāʾ because it is a dual. ﴿مِنْ دُونِ﴾ attached to the verb اتخذوني or to an omitted adjective of إلهين; and the clause اتخذوني is the speech reported by the verb of saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿قالَ سُبْحانَكَ﴾ سبحانك is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿ما يَكُونُ لِي أَنْ أَقُولَ﴾ ما is negating, with no governing effect; يكون: a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb; the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿لِي﴾ are attached to its omitted khabar, and its noun is the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from أن and the verb أقول after it; and the clause ما يكون is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿ما لَيْسَ لِي بِحَقٍّ﴾ ما: a relative noun in the position of accusative as the direct object of أقول; ليس: a defective past verb. ﴿بِحَقٍّ﴾ the bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; حق: a noun genitive in form, accusative in position, the khabar of ليس; لي is attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from حق — it was an adjective of it, and when placed ahead of it, it became a ḥāl; and the clause ليس is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿إِنْ كُنْتُ قُلْتُهُ﴾ إن: a jussive conditional particle. كنت: a defective past verb in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the tāʾ is its noun. قلته: past verb, fāʿil and direct object; and the clause is the khabar of كنت. ﴿فَقَدْ عَلِمْتَهُ﴾ the fāʾ connects the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); قد: a particle of verification (taḥqīq); علمته: past verb, fāʿil and direct object; and the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis; and the clause إن كنت has no grammatical position, being resumptive. ﴿تَعْلَمُ ما فِي نَفْسِي﴾ ما: a relative noun in the position of accusative as direct object; في نفسي is attached to an omitted ṣila of the relative noun; تعلم: and the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position. [Translator's note: the wording «تعلم والجملة» is so in the source.] ﴿وَلا أَعْلَمُ ما فِي نَفْسِكَ﴾ its i'rab is approximately like the preceding one, and it is conjoined to it. ﴿إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ عَلَّامُ الْغُيُوبِ﴾ أنت علام: mubtadaʾ and khabar; the nominal clause is the khabar of إنّ, and the kāf is its noun; and the clause إنك is causal.

daas-irab:117-117.t: ﴿ما قُلْتُ لَهُمْ﴾ past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq); the tāʾ is its fāʿil (agent); ما is negating, with no governing effect. ﴿إِلَّا ما أَمَرْتَنِي بِهِ﴾ إلا: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ما: a relative noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). أمرتني: past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn; the tāʾ is its fāʿil, the nūn is for protection (nūn al-wiqāya), and the yāʾ is a direct object; and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. به is attached to the verb أمرتني. ﴿أَنِ اعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ﴾ أن is explicative (mufassira); اعبدوا: imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil and الله, the Name of Majesty, its object. ﴿رَبِّي وَرَبَّكُمْ﴾ ربي: a badal (substitute), accusative with the fatḥa implied (muqaddara) on the letter before the yāʾ of the first person, and the yāʾ is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); and ربكم is conjoined. It is also permissible for ﴿أَنِ﴾ to be a maṣdar-forming, subjunctive-governing particle; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from it and the verb after it is then in the position of genitive as a badal from the hāʾ in به, or in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), implied as «it». ﴿وَكُنْتُ عَلَيْهِمْ شَهِيداً﴾ شهيدا: khabar of كان, to which the preposition and its genitive noun before it are attached; the tāʾ is its noun; and the clause is conjoined. ﴿ما دُمْتُ فِيهِمْ﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb; the tāʾ is its noun, and فيهم is attached to its omitted khabar. And ما «its noun» after it is interpretable as a maṣdar in the position of genitive by annexation: «the duration of my remaining among them». [Translator's note: so in the source, «وما اسمها بعدها»; presumably «ما and what follows it» is meant.] ﴿فَلَمَّا تَوَفَّيْتَنِي﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive. لما: an adverb of time (ẓarfiyya ḥīniyya), or a non-jussive conditional particle; توفيتني: past verb, its fāʿil and its object, and the nūn is for protection; and the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation. ﴿كُنْتَ أَنْتَ الرَّقِيبَ عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ كان, and the tāʾ is its noun; الرقيب its khabar, to which the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ are attached. أنت: a detached pronoun, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of nominative as a badal from the tāʾ, or a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position; and the clause كنت is the response to لما, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَأَنْتَ عَلى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ شَهِيدٌ﴾ أنت شهيد: mubtadaʾ and khabar, to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; and the clause is resumptive or circumstantial (ḥāliyya).

daas-irab:118-118.t: ﴿إِنْ تُعَذِّبْهُمْ﴾ إن is a jussive conditional particle, and تعذبهم is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa); and the clause ﴿فَإِنَّهُمْ عِبادُكَ﴾ is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); and it has been said that it is causal (taʿlīliyya) and the apodosis is omitted. And similarly ﴿وَإِنْ تَغْفِرْ لَهُمْ، فَإِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ﴾ إنّ, its noun and its two khabars (predicates); and the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis.

daas-irab:119-119.t:
﴿قالَ اللَّهُ﴾ the verbal clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿هذا يَوْمُ﴾ ذا: a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject), and يوم its khabar (predicate); and the clause is the speech reported by the verb of saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿يَنْفَعُ الصَّادِقِينَ صِدْقُهُمْ﴾ ينفع: imperfect verb, its object, and its postponed fāʿil (agent); and the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa).
﴿لَهُمْ جَنَّاتٌ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ جنات; and the clause is resumptive. And the clause ﴿تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهارُ﴾ is in the position of nominative as an adjective of جنات. ﴿خالِدِينَ﴾ a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative with the yāʾ. ﴿فِيها﴾ attached to خالدين, and likewise the adverb ﴿أَبَداً﴾ is attached to خالدين. ﴿رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ﴾ past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; the Name of Majesty is its fāʿil; and the clause is resumptive; and the clause ﴿رَضُوا عَنْهُ﴾ is conjoined to it. ﴿ذلِكَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيمُ﴾ mubtadaʾ and khabar, and العظيم is an adjective; and the clause is also resumptive.

daas-irab:120-120.t: ﴿لِلَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, genitive by the lām; [the two] are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿مُلْكُ﴾ postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿السَّماواتِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَما﴾ a relative noun conjoined to ملك, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of nominative. ﴿فِيهِنَّ﴾ attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ما; and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَهُوَ عَلى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ﴾ هو: mubtadaʾ, and قدير: khabar, to which the preposition and its genitive noun على كل are attached; and قدير is muḍāf ilayhi [Translator's note: so in the source; the muḍāf ilayhi is شيء]; and the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:37-37.t: ﴿يُرِيدُونَ﴾ a nominative (marfūʿ) imperfect verb, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent). ﴿أَنْ يَخْرُجُوا﴾ an accusative (manṣūb) imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿مِنَ النَّارِ﴾ the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them. ﴿وَما هُمْ بِخارِجِينَ﴾ ما is the Ḥijāzī ما, working like laysa; the detached pronoun is its noun and بخارجين its khabar (predicate), the bāʾ being a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿مِنْها﴾ the two are attached to the active participle خارجين; the clause ﴿وَما هُمْ..﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial) clause. ﴿وَلَهُمْ عَذابٌ مُقِيمٌ﴾ لهم: the two are attached to the omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ (subject) عذاب, and مقيم is its naʿt (adjective); the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:38-39.t: ﴿وَالسَّارِقُ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; السارق is a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is omitted, i.e. "[is] in what is recited to you", on the basis of omission of the muḍāf with the muḍāf ilayhi retained, the implied form being: "the ruling on the male thief and the female thief is in what.." (حكم السارق والسارقة فيما..). ﴿وَالسَّارِقَةُ﴾ conjoined. ﴿فَاقْطَعُوا أَيْدِيَهُما﴾ an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent), and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) with the fatḥa. ﴿جَزاءً﴾ a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). ﴿بِما كَسَبا﴾ a past verb, and the alif is the fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from maṣdariyya ما and the verb is in the position of the genitive by the preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the maṣdar ﴿جَزاءً﴾; it is also permissible for ما to be a relative. ﴿نَكالًا﴾ a mafʿūl li-ajlihi, or a badal (substitute) of جزاء. ﴿مِنَ اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty is genitive by من, the two being attached to نكالا. ﴿وَاللَّهُ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ﴾ the Name of Majesty is a mubtadaʾ, with its two khabars, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَمَنْ تابَ مِنْ بَعْدِ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb before them, which is in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the conditional noun من is a mubtadaʾ. ﴿ظُلْمِهِ﴾ a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَأَصْلَحَ﴾ conjoined to تاب. ﴿فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ يَتُوبُ عَلَيْهِ﴾ inna, with the Name of Majesty as its noun, and the clause is its khabar; the clause ﴿إِنَّ﴾ is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and this apodosis together with the protasis is the khabar of من. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ﴾ inna, with the Name of Majesty as its noun, and غفور and رحيم are its two khabars; the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:40-40.t: ﴿أَلَمْ تَعْلَمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لم, and the hamza is for interrogation. ﴿أَنَّ اللَّهَ لَهُ مُلْكُ السَّماواتِ وَالْأَرْضِ﴾ له: the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) ملك; the nominal clause is the khabar of anna, and الله, the Name of Majesty, is its noun; السموات is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct) and الأرض is conjoined. ﴿يُعَذِّبُ مَنْ يَشاءُ﴾ the relative noun is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the verb يعذب; the clause is resumptive, and the clause ﴿يَشاءُ﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَيَغْفِرُ لِمَنْ يَشاءُ﴾ لمن: the two are attached to يغفر, and the clause is conjoined. Anna and what follows it take the place of the two objects of تعلم. ﴿وَاللَّهُ عَلى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ﴾ الله, the Name of Majesty, is a mubtadaʾ, and قدير is the khabar, to which the preposition and its genitive noun before it are attached; the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:41-41.t: ﴿يا أَيُّهَا﴾ يا is the vocative particle; أي is the one addressed (munādā), muḍāf [Translator's note: so in the source; elsewhere أيّ here is parsed as an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable on the ḍamma]. ﴿الرَّسُولُ﴾ a badal (substitute). ﴿لا يَحْزُنْكَ الَّذِينَ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لا; the kāf is its object and the relative noun its fāʿil (agent); the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), and the clause ﴿يُسارِعُونَ فِي الْكُفْرِ﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿مِنَ الَّذِينَ﴾ the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), and the clause ﴿قالُوا﴾ is the ṣila. ﴿آمَنَّا﴾ a past verb, and نا is its fāʿil; the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech). ﴿بِأَفْواهِهِمْ﴾ the two are attached to قالوا. ﴿وَلَمْ تُؤْمِنْ قُلُوبُهُمْ﴾ a jussive imperfect verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl. ﴿وَمِنَ الَّذِينَ هادُوا﴾ conjoined to الذين قالوا. ﴿سَمَّاعُونَ﴾ the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being: "they are listeners" (هم سماعون). ﴿لِلْكَذِبِ﴾ the two are attached to سماعون. ﴿سَمَّاعُونَ لِقَوْمٍ آخَرِينَ﴾ a badal from the first سماعون, to which the preposition and its genitive noun after it are attached, and آخرين is a naʿt (adjective). ﴿لَمْ يَأْتُوكَ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive by the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil and the kāf its object; the clause is a second naʿt of قوم. ﴿يُحَرِّفُونَ الْكَلِمَ مِنْ بَعْدِ مَواضِعِهِ﴾ يحرفون is an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, with its fāʿil and its object; مواضعه is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and there is an omitted muḍāf, i.e. "after its being placed in its places" (من بعد وضعه في مواضعه). ﴿يَقُولُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is resumptive; the clause ﴿يُحَرِّفُونَ﴾ is a third naʿt. ﴿إِنْ أُوتِيتُمْ هذا﴾ أوتيتم is a past verb, passive (mabnī li-l-majhūl), in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the tāʾ is its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and the demonstrative is its second object, the nāʾib fāʿil being the first object. ﴿فَخُذُوهُ﴾ the fāʾ is linking; an imperative verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿وَإِنْ لَمْ تُؤْتَوْهُ فَاحْذَرُوا﴾ a passive imperfect verb, jussive by لم, and it is the protasis; the wāw is its nāʾib fāʿil and the hāʾ its second object; فاحذروا: the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis. ﴿وَمَنْ يُرِدِ اللَّهُ فِتْنَتَهُ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its object, and the conditional noun is a mubtadaʾ. ﴿فَلَنْ تَمْلِكَ لَهُ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb before them, and the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis. ﴿مِنَ اللَّهِ شَيْئاً﴾ من الله: the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl from the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) after them. ﴿أُولئِكَ الَّذِينَ﴾ the demonstrative is a mubtadaʾ and the relative noun its khabar. ﴿لَمْ يُرِدِ اللَّهُ أَنْ يُطَهِّرَ﴾ a jussive imperfect verb; the Name of Majesty is its fāʿil and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) its object; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿قُلُوبُهُمْ﴾ the object of يطهر. ﴿لَهُمْ فِي الدُّنْيا خِزْيٌ﴾ لهم: the two are attached to the omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ خزي. ﴿فِي الدُّنْيا﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl, and the clause is a second khabar of the demonstrative. ﴿وَلَهُمْ فِي الْآخِرَةِ عَذابٌ﴾ conjoined. ﴿عَظِيمٌ﴾ a naʿt.

daas-irab:42-42.t:
﴿سَمَّاعُونَ لِلْكَذِبِ﴾ سماعون is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "they" (هم), and the preposition and its genitive noun after it are attached (mutaʿalliq) to it.
And likewise ﴿أَكَّالُونَ لِلسُّحْتِ﴾. ﴿فَإِنْ جاؤُكَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its object; it is in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿فَاحْكُمْ بَيْنَهُمْ﴾ an imperative verb to which the adverb after it is attached. The clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), because it is joined to the linking fāʾ. ﴿أَوْ أَعْرِضْ عَنْهُمْ﴾ an imperative verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun after it are attached; its fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَإِنْ تُعْرِضْ عَنْهُمْ﴾ إن is conditional; تعرض is a jussive (majzūm) imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun after it are attached; its fāʿil is latent, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿شَيْئاً﴾ a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿وَإِنْ حَكَمْتَ﴾ إن is conditional, and a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿فَاحْكُمْ بَيْنَهُمْ بِالْقِسْطِ﴾ the fāʾ is linking; an imperative verb to which the adverb and the preposition with its genitive noun after it are attached; the fāʿil is latent, and the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ inna, with the Name of Majesty as its noun, and the clause ﴿يُحِبُّ الْمُقْسِطِينَ﴾ is its khabar.
