daas-irab:43-43.t: ﴿وَكَيْفَ﴾ an interrogative noun in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial); the wāw is resumptive. ﴿يُحَكِّمُونَكَ﴾ an imperfect verb; the wāw is its fāʿil (agent) and the kāf its object; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَعِنْدَهُمُ التَّوْراةُ﴾ التوراة is a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is omitted, the adverb عندهم being attached to it. ﴿فِيها حُكْمُ اللَّهِ﴾ حكم is a mubtadaʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun فيها are attached to (mutaʿalliq) its omitted khabar; الله, the Name of Majesty, is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿ثُمَّ يَتَوَلَّوْنَ مِنْ بَعْدِ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾ a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿وَما أُولئِكَ﴾ ما is Ḥijāzī, working like laysa, and the demonstrative is in the position of the nominative as its noun. ﴿بِالْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ its khabar, accusative in position and genitive in form because of the redundant (zāʾida) bāʾ before it; the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:44-44.t:
﴿إِنَّا﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿أَنْزَلْنَا التَّوْراةَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of inna. ﴿فِيها هُدىً وَنُورٌ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ (subject) هدى. ﴿يَحْكُمُ بِهَا النَّبِيُّونَ﴾ يحكم is an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and النبيون is its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿الَّذِينَ أَسْلَمُوا﴾ a relative noun in the position of the nominative as a naʿt (adjective), and the clause أسلموا is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿لِلَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun in the position of the genitive by the preposition; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to يحكم, and the clause ﴿هادُوا﴾ is the ṣila. ﴿وَالرَّبَّانِيُّونَ وَالْأَحْبارُ﴾ conjoined to النبيون. ﴿بِمَا اسْتُحْفِظُوا﴾ بما: the two are attached to يحكم; استحفظوا is a past verb, passive (mabnī li-l-majhūl), the wāw is its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿مِنْ كِتابِ﴾ the two are attached to the verb before them. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَكانُوا عَلَيْهِ شُهَداءَ﴾ kāna, its noun and its khabar; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the khabar شهداء, and the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَلا تَخْشَوُا النَّاسَ﴾ تخشوا is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn, with its fāʿil and its object; the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ implying an omitted condition), and لا is the jussivizing lā of prohibition.
﴿وَاخْشَوْنِ﴾ an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), the wāw is the fāʿil, and the omitted yāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَلا تَشْتَرُوا بِآياتِي﴾ لا is the lā of prohibition; تشتروا is an imperfect verb, jussive by the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil. The preposition and its genitive noun after it are attached to it. ﴿ثَمَناً﴾ its object. ﴿قَلِيلًا﴾ a naʿt. ﴿وَمَنْ لَمْ يَحْكُمْ بِما أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; من is a jussivizing conditional noun, a mubtadaʾ; يحكم is a jussive imperfect verb, and بما: the two are attached to يحكم. ﴿أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ﴾ a past verb, and the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿فَأُولئِكَ﴾ the fāʾ occurs in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿أولئك﴾ a demonstrative, indeclinable on the kasra, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ. ﴿هُمُ﴾ a detached pronoun in the position of the nominative as a second mubtadaʾ. ﴿الْكافِرُونَ﴾ the khabar of the second mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause is the khabar of the first mubtadaʾ, and the clause فأولئك is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis. The protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ) and its apodosis are the khabar of the mubtadaʾ من.

daas-irab:45-45.t: ﴿وَكَتَبْنا عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb, and likewise ﴿فِيها﴾ is attached to the verb; the clause is conjoined to the clause أنزلنا. ﴿أَنَّ النَّفْسَ بِالنَّفْسِ﴾ anna and its noun; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted khabar (predicate), i.e. "killed (مقتولة) for the soul"; anna and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of the accusative as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of كتبنا. Likewise what follows it, i.e.: ﴿وَالْعَيْنَ﴾ "gouged out" (مقلوعة) ﴿بِالْعَيْنِ﴾, ﴿وَالْأَنْفَ﴾ "cut off" (مجدوع) ﴿بِالْأَنْفِ﴾, ﴿وَالْأُذُنَ﴾ "cut off" (مصلومة) ﴿بِالْأُذُنِ﴾, ﴿وَالسِّنَّ﴾ "pulled out" (مقلوعة) ﴿بِالسِّنِّ﴾, ﴿وَالْجُرُوحَ﴾ "retaliated for in kind" (مقصوص بها قصاصا). ﴿فَمَنْ تَصَدَّقَ بِهِ﴾ تصدق is a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun after it are attached, and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the conditional noun is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the fāʾ is resumptive. ﴿فَهُوَ كَفَّارَةٌ لَهُ﴾ the fāʾ is linking, [followed by] a mubtadaʾ and khabar; the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿وَمَنْ لَمْ يَحْكُمْ بِما أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ﴾ the i'rab of something similar has preceded in the previous verse.

daas-irab:46-46.t: ﴿وَقَفَّيْنا عَلى آثارِهِمْ بِعِيسَى﴾ a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun على آثارهم are attached (mutaʿalliq), and likewise بعيسى; نا is its fāʿil (agent), and the clause is conjoined. ﴿ابْنِ﴾ a genitive (majrūr) naʿt (adjective) or badal (substitute). ﴿مَرْيَمَ﴾ a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive with the fatḥa because it is a diptote (mamnūʿ min al-ṣarf), being a proper name and feminine. ﴿مُصَدِّقاً﴾ a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿لِما﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to مصدقا. ﴿بَيْنَ﴾ the adverb is attached to the omitted ṣila (relative clause). ﴿يَدَيْهِ﴾ a muḍāf ilayhi, genitive with the yāʾ because it is dual. ﴿مِنَ التَّوْراةِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿وَآتَيْناهُ الْإِنْجِيلَ﴾ a past verb and its two objects, and نا is its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فِيهِ هُدىً﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun فيه are attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) هدى. ﴿وَنُورٌ﴾ conjoined, and the nominal clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl. ﴿مُصَدِّقاً لِما بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ مِنَ التَّوْراةِ﴾ its i'rab has preceded. ﴿وَهُدىً وَمَوْعِظَةً﴾ conjoined to ﴿مُصَدِّقاً﴾. ﴿لِلْمُتَّقِينَ﴾ the two are attached to موعظة.

daas-irab:47-47.t: ﴿وَلْيَحْكُمْ أَهْلُ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the lām of command, and أهل is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is conjoined. It was also read with a kasra on the lām, as the lām of reason (taʿlīl), with the imperfect verb in the accusative. ﴿الْإِنْجِيلِ﴾ a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿بِما﴾ the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) يحكم. ﴿أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ﴾ a past verb, and the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil. ﴿فِيهِ﴾ the two are attached to أنزل, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of ما. ﴿وَمَنْ لَمْ يَحْكُمْ بِما أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ فَأُولئِكَ هُمُ الْفاسِقُونَ﴾ for its i'rab see verse 45 [Translator's note: so in the source; the parallel phrase is parsed in full under verse 44].

daas-irab:48-48.t: ﴿وَأَنْزَلْنا إِلَيْكَ الْكِتابَ﴾ a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq); نا is its fāʿil (agent) and الكتاب its object. ﴿بِالْحَقِّ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from الكتاب. ﴿مُصَدِّقاً﴾ a second ḥāl. ﴿لِما﴾ the two are attached to مصدقا. ﴿بَيْنَ﴾ an adverb attached to the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ما. ﴿مِنَ الْكِتابِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿وَمُهَيْمِناً﴾ conjoined to ﴿مُصَدِّقاً﴾. ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾ the two are attached to what precedes them. ﴿فَاحْكُمْ بَيْنَهُمْ﴾ an imperative verb to which the adverb after it is attached; the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ implying an omitted condition), and the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of an implied condition. ﴿بِما﴾ the two are attached to أنزل الله [Translator's note: so in the source; بما is attached to احكم, and أنزل الله is its ṣila]; the clause is the ṣila of ما. ﴿وَلا تَتَّبِعْ أَهْواءَهُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لا, with its object, and its fāʿil is "you" (أنت); the clause is conjoined. ﴿عَمَّا جاءَكَ﴾ عما: the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl, its implied form being: "turning away from what has come to you" (مائلا عما جاءك); the clause is the ṣila. ﴿مِنَ الْحَقِّ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl from the latent (mustatir) fāʿil of جاءك. ﴿لِكُلٍّ﴾ the two are attached to جعلنا after them, or are the first object of جعلنا. ﴿مِنْكُمْ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of the omitted noun for which the compensatory tanwīn (tanwīn al-ʿiwaḍ) in كل stands, the implied form being: "for every community" (لكل أمة). ﴿شِرْعَةً﴾ the object of جعل. ﴿وَمِنْهاجاً﴾ conjoined, and the verbal clause is resumptive. ﴿وَلَوْ شاءَ اللَّهُ﴾ a past verb, and the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil; لو is conditional. ﴿لَجَعَلَكُمْ أُمَّةً واحِدَةً﴾ the kāf is the first object of جعل and أمة its second object; واحدة is a naʿt; and the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of conditional لو. ﴿وَلكِنْ لِيَبْلُوَكُمْ﴾ لكن is a particle of rectification (istidrāk) with no governing effect because it is lightened. ليبلوكم: the lām is the lām of reason (taʿlīl); يبلوكم is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām of reason, and the kāf is its object; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from أن and the verb is in the position of the genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the omitted verb "He willed" (أراد); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿فِي ما آتاكُمْ﴾ فيما: the two are attached to يبلوكم, and the clause آتاكم is the ṣila, with no grammatical position. ﴿فَاسْتَبِقُوا الْخَيْراتِ﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa, i.e. "if you know this, then race"; استبقوا الخيرات: an imperative verb, the wāw is its fāʿil and الخيرات its object; the clause has no grammatical position. ﴿إِلَى اللَّهِ مَرْجِعُكُمْ﴾ the Name of Majesty is genitive by إلى, the two being attached to the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) مرجعكم; the clause is resumptive. ﴿جَمِيعاً﴾ a ḥāl. ﴿فَيُنَبِّئُكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the kāf is its object; the clause is conjoined. ﴿بِما كُنْتُمْ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb before them, and the clause كنتم is the ṣila, with no grammatical position. ﴿فِيهِ تَخْتَلِفُونَ﴾ the clause is the khabar of كنتم, and فيه: the two are attached to the verb after it.

daas-irab:49-49.t: ﴿وَأَنِ احْكُمْ بَيْنَهُمْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; subjunctive أن and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted verb: "and We enjoined upon you to judge" (ووصيناك بالحكم); the adverb is attached to the verb before it. ﴿بِما أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ، وَلا تَتَّبِعْ أَهْواءَهُمْ﴾ its i'rab has preceded in the previous verse. ﴿وَاحْذَرْهُمْ أَنْ يَفْتِنُوكَ﴾ the hāʾ is the object of the verb احذر; أن يفتنوك: the interpreted maṣdar is accusative by removal of the preposition: "beware of the temptation" (احذر الفتنة). ﴿عَنْ بَعْضِ﴾ the two are attached to the verb before them. ﴿ما أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ إِلَيْكَ﴾ أنزل is a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and the Name of Majesty is its fāʿil (agent); the relative noun is in the position of the genitive by annexation, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. ﴿فَإِنْ تَوَلَّوْا﴾ a past verb in the position of the jussive by conditional إن, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive, after the resumptive fāʾ. ﴿فَاعْلَمْ أَنَّما يُرِيدُ اللَّهُ أَنْ يُصِيبَهُمْ بِبَعْضِ ذُنُوبِهِمْ﴾ أن and the verb يصيب after it are interpreted as a maṣdar in the position of the accusative as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the verb يريد, and الله, the Name of Majesty, is its fāʿil. أنما is the restraining and restrained (kāffa wa-makfūfa) particle with no governing effect, and it takes the place of the two objects of اعلم before it; the clause اعلم is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ببعض: the two are attached to يصيبهم, and ذنوبهم is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَإِنَّ كَثِيراً مِنَ النَّاسِ لَفاسِقُونَ﴾ من الناس: the two are attached to the khabar (predicate) of inna, ﴿لَفاسِقُونَ﴾, or to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of كثير; the lām is the shifted lām (muzaḥlaqa) on the khabar of inna, and كثيرا is its noun.

daas-irab:50-50.t: ﴿أَفَحُكْمَ الْجاهِلِيَّةِ يَبْغُونَ﴾ يبغون is an imperfect verb, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); حكم is a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and الجاهلية a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the hamza at the start of the clause is for interrogation, and the clause, after the resumptive fāʾ, is resumptive. ﴿وَمَنْ أَحْسَنُ مِنَ اللَّهِ حُكْماً﴾ من is an interrogative noun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), and أحسن is its khabar (predicate), to which the preposition and its genitive noun after it are attached (mutaʿalliq); حكما is a tamyīz (specification). ﴿لِقَوْمٍ﴾ the two are attached to حكما or to أحسن, in which case the lām means "in the view of" (عند). ﴿يُوقِنُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of the genitive as a naʿt (adjective) of قوم.

daas-irab:51-51.t: ﴿يا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا﴾ its i'rab has preceded. ﴿لا تَتَّخِذُوا الْيَهُودَ وَالنَّصارى أَوْلِياءَ﴾ تتخذوا is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn because it is preceded by the jussivizing lā of prohibition; the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); اليهود is its first object and أولياء its second object; النصارى is conjoined to اليهود. ﴿بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلِياءُ بَعْضٍ﴾ بعضهم is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and أولياء its khabar (predicate); بعض is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya) with no grammatical position, and the clause لا تتخذوا before it is resumptive, likewise with no grammatical position. ﴿وَمَنْ يَتَوَلَّهُمْ مِنْكُمْ﴾ من is a jussivizing conditional noun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ; يتولهم is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), jussive by the dropping of the weak letter; منكم: the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَإِنَّهُ مِنْهُمْ﴾ inna, with the hāʾ as its noun, and the preposition and its genitive noun as its khabar; the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), because it is joined to the linking fāʾ; the clause of protasis and apodosis is the khabar of من. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ لا يَهْدِي الْقَوْمَ الظَّالِمِينَ﴾ the Name of Majesty is the noun of inna; لا is negative; يهدي is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the yāʾ; القوم is its object, and its fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "he" (هو); الظالمين is an accusative naʿt (adjective), with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause لا يهدي is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of inna, and the clause إن الله is resumptive.

daas-irab:52-52.t: ﴿فَتَرَى الَّذِينَ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the relative noun is its object; the clause is resumptive after the fāʾ. ﴿فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ مَرَضٌ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) مرض, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. ﴿يُسارِعُونَ فِيهِمْ﴾ an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun فيهم are attached, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿يَقُولُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿نَخْشى أَنْ تُصِيبَنا دائِرَةٌ﴾ تصيبنا is an accusative (manṣūb) imperfect verb; نا is its object and دائرة its fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from أن and the verb is in the position of the accusative as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the verb نخشى; the clause نخشى is in the position of the accusative as a mafʿūl bihi, the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech); and the clause يقولون is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl. ﴿فَعَسَى اللَّهُ أَنْ يَأْتِيَ بِالْفَتْحِ﴾ عسى is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the alif; الله, the Name of Majesty, is its noun; the interpreted maṣdar formed from أن and the verb after it is its khabar; بالفتح: the two are attached to يأتي. ﴿أَوْ أَمْرٍ مِنْ عِنْدِهِ﴾ أمر is conjoined to الفتح, and من عنده: the two are attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of أمر; the clause عسى is resumptive. ﴿فَيُصْبِحُوا عَلى ما أَسَرُّوا فِي أَنْفُسِهِمْ نادِمِينَ﴾ the fāʾ is causal (sababiyya); يصبحوا is an incomplete imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after the fāʾ; the wāw is its noun and نادمين its khabar, to which the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿عَلى ما﴾ are attached. أسروا is a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun في أنفسهم are attached, and the clause أسروا is the ṣila, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:53-53.t: ﴿وَيَقُولُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا﴾ الذين is a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the nominative as the fāʿil (agent) of يقول; آمنوا is a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position; the clause يقول is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿أَهؤُلاءِ﴾ the hamza is an interrogative particle. ﴿هؤُلاءِ﴾ a demonstrative, indeclinable on the kasra, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), and the relative noun after it is its khabar (predicate); the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech). ﴿أَقْسَمُوا بِاللَّهِ﴾ a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun after it are attached (mutaʿalliq), and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila, with no grammatical position. ﴿جَهْدَ أَيْمانِهِمْ﴾ جهد is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) and أيمانهم a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿إِنَّهُمْ لَمَعَكُمْ﴾ inna, with the hāʾ as its noun; in لمعكم the lām is the shifted lām (muzaḥlaqa), and the adverb مع is attached to the omitted khabar of inna; the clause has no grammatical position, being the response to an oath. ﴿حَبِطَتْ أَعْمالُهُمْ﴾ حبط is a past verb and أعمالهم the fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَأَصْبَحُوا خاسِرِينَ﴾ the clause of the incomplete (nāqiṣ) verb أصبح with its noun and its khabar after it is conjoined to the clause حبطت.
